samples.question: A dark reference disk is shown in the box at the top of the image. Below it, the image is split into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), each containing one dark filled disk. Exactly one quadrant's disk has the SAME size (the same radius) as the reference disk; the other three disks each have a clearly different radius. Which quadrant contains the disk whose radius matches the reference disk?
